nodes.label: Equity Curve Chart
nodes.description: Cumulative equity curve in units of risk (R) over time, showing portfolio growth from mid-2024 through mid-2026. Peak equity reached approximately 22R around 2025-08.

nodes.label: Per-Trade P&L Panel
nodes.description: Bar chart of individual trade P&L in R, showing winning trades (green bars, up to +2R) and losing trades (red bars, down to -1R) across the backtest period.

nodes.label: Real EUR/USD Backtest (docs)
nodes.description: Two-panel backtest results chart for EUR/USD. Title: 'Equity curve — кумулативный результат в единицах риска'. X-axis spans 2024-06 to 2026-06. Y-axis (top): Equity in R, ranging from roughly -2 to 22. Y-axis (bottom): P&L per trade in R. Strategy appears risk-based with fixed R per trade, max win ~2R, max loss ~1R.
